sn36.15:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca || ||
sn36.15:1.2: Katamā nu kho bhante vedanā || katamo vedanāsamudayo || katamo vedanānirodho || katamā vedanānirodhagāminīpaṭipadā ||
sn36.15:1.3: ko vedanāya assādo || ko ādīnavo || kiṃ nissaraṇanti || || 4
sn36.15:1.5: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā
sn36.15:1.9: Ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo vedanānirodhagāminī patipadā || seyyathīdaṃ
sn36.15:1.11: Yaṃ vedanaṃ paticca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassam ayam vedanāya assādo || ||
sn36.15:1.12: Yā vedanā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā ayaṃ vedanāya ādīnavo || ||
sn36.15:1.13: Yo vedanāya chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānam idaṃ vedanāya nissaraṇaṃ || || 5
sn36.15:1.14: Atha kho panānanda mayā anupubbasaṅkhārānaṃ nirodho akkhāto || ||
sn36.15:1.15: Pathamaṃ jhānam samāpannassa vācā niruddhā hoti || pe ||
sn36.15:1.16: saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca niruddhā honti || ||
sn36.15:1.17: Khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo niruddho hoti || doso niruddho hoti || moho niruddho hoti || || 6
sn36.15:1.18: Atha kho panānanda mayā anupubbaṃ saṅkhārānam vūpasamo akkhāto || ||
sn36.15:1.19: Pathamaṃ jhānam samāpannassa vācā vūpasantā hoti || pe ||
sn36.15:1.20: saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca vūpasantā honti || ||
sn36.15:1.21: Khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo vūpasanto hoti || doso vūpasanto || moho vūpasanto hoti || || 7
sn36.15:1.22: Atha kho panānanda mayā anupubbaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ passaddhi akkhātā || ||
sn36.15:1.23: Pathamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vācā paṭippassaddhā hoti || la ||
sn36.15:1.28: saññāvedayitānirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca paṭippassaddhā || honti || ||
sn36.15:1.29: Khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo paṭippassaddho hoti || doso paṭippassaddho hoti || moho paṭippassaddho hotīti || || 2
